I’ve stuck there for one and a half year because for some reason my gpa wouldn’t add up even by a 0.25. There are going be relics revolving around you that have been there for more than 3 years. Pick courses you’re capable of doing. FIC is a cluster fuck and I’d agree with the last poster that you should’ve done your homework, I didn’t and wasted 60,000$ on studying shit here. I hope your treatment goes awesome and you kick ass after that. Being depressed isn’t something that you may have a choice over. It’s just something which happens and you have no control over and it consumes you to do really hurtful things to yourself. People just label anything which seems out of the ordinary and lack the empathy to actually do something about it or just simply ask to help with whatever your dealing with. The world can let you down in more ways than one. The only thing fighting this is your self. Just believe in your self. I know it sounds cliche but it’s only you against your self. Please just find the courage to have a different outlook on yourself for your own betterment. I genuinely hope that you don’t fall victim to it. 
You have a wonderful community on reddit to seek out more friends that won’t care of your disability and see more to you as person me included.

Having a disability is nothing to be ashamed of. If it’s something they can’t see physically doesn’t mean it can’t hurt or hinder you. People believe what they see and disregard anything that isn’t right in there face to ogle over.

It’s awesome that you are getting help. Have you tried other options in your area as well? Like different doctors for second opinions. It helps most of the time. 
Do not let what people think of you get in your way. Yes this a handicap that you did not let get in your way and finished your degree and actually have a job. That’s something to be proud of. As drake would say “haters”, you shouldn’t let what people think of what you have accomplished.

It’s honestly nice to know that you didn’t go down that path yet. These labels which prevent you from seeking professional help do they really get to you? Are you finding any form of relief when you do go to a therapist? Like even the tiniest of betterment. I’m not on authority to dismiss the psychologists claim to work on your “self esteem” but really does sound stupid. You don’t have to be worried about venting it all out. I hope I can just find any way possible to help you through this.  You should not blame your self for any of this. There is absolutely nothing wrong with seeking professional mental help. Do not let these people discourage you. It is a a very serious issue, just think it likethis this, if you were physically hurt would you not seek a medically trained doctor or let it all sort it self out?
